definitions.explanation: Physical or metaphorical space that allows for something additional.
The potential or opportunity for something to occur or be done.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧{余地|よち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There isn't even room to sit down anymore.
There is no more room on this shelf to put books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{疑|うたが}う→疑う：01889_utagau⟧{余地|よち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no room for doubt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}されている→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: There is still room for negotiation.

notes:

{余|よ} (extra, surplus) + {地|ち} (ground, space)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - there is room for ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - there is no room for ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ - to leave room for ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち} - room for improvement

- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余地|よち} - room for negotiation
